Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1170
Claimant:
Gabriela Watkins
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
15 Jul 2025
The claimant reported a rear-end collision at a stop and said the other vehicle struck them from behind while they
were stopped in traffic. Initial intake recorded neck and back strain as the injuries described.
6 Oct 2025
The claimant's account of the crash has stayed the same in every conversation so far, including the sequence of
events and the position of both vehicles. The driver is named on the policy, and coverage was in force at the time of
loss.
13 Oct 2025
Police and two independent witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle and that the impact occurred as
described. The other driver has also given a statement that matches the claimant's version.
14 Nov 2025
Photos from the scene show rear-end damage that lines up well with the described impact. Repair estimates for the
vehicle follow the same damage pattern, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is known from our records or the prior
claims search.
22 Dec 2025
The reported neck and back strain fits the kind and force of a rear impact of this type. Medical records show no earlier
injury to the same body areas.
25 Dec 2025
Treatment has continued for somewhat longer than is typical for this injury, with follow-up visits spread over several
weeks. The treating provider has documented ongoing symptoms and a plan for physical therapy.
4 Jan 2026
Nothing in the file suggests the vehicle damage occurred before the policy coverage began. The effective date and
the loss timeline remain consistent across the policy records and the claim intake.
1 Feb 2026
The claimant is not represented by an attorney and has been cooperative with requests for records and a recorded
statement. No contact from outside representation has been received to date.
4 Feb 2026
Based on the current file, the claim is progressing normally, and the bodily injury evaluation will continue once the
final treatment records are received. Next steps are to obtain the outstanding imaging reports and schedule a
follow-up with the claimant.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
